items.title: Introducing simplified onboarding for AWS WAF Bot Control at the targeted inspection level
items.summary: Today, we’re announcing simplified onboarding and bot confidence levels for AWS WAF Bot Control at the targeted inspection level, which we refer to as Targeted bot control in this post, matching the console.
